title: Metabo ya Maarifa #1: Nilijua Zaidi. Nilisogea Kidogo.

text.A story about getting too full of inform: Hadithi kuhusu kujazwa na habari nyingi
text.AirPods surrounded by Spotify, YouTube,: AirPods zimezungukwa na Spotify, YouTube, Inasikika, na The Daily
text.I am the kind of person who wears AirPod: Mimi ni aina ya mtu ambaye huvaa AirPods siku nzima. Ni kwa sababu ninataka kuweka aina fulani ya habari kichwani mwangu. Ninaposonga, nikifanya kazi za nyumbani, na kabla ya kulala, mimi huweka Sauti, podikasti za Spotify au YouTube kucheza. Hata ninapolala, kukaa kimya hunifanya nijisikie kwamba ni lazima nijifunze kitu au nifanye jambo fulani, hivyo kusikiliza habari imekuwa tabia yangu ya kila siku.
text.I felt like I was getting smarter. But I: Nilihisi kana kwamba ninakuwa nadhifu. Lakini sikuwa nasogea hata kidogo. Pia, kwa namna fulani, nilikuwa nimechoka kila wakati.
text.Food becomes fat if you do not use it. T: Chakula kinakuwa mafuta ikiwa hutumii. Mambo unayosikia yanaweza kuwa sawa. Usipozitumia, hukaa ndani kwani “labda nitazitumia siku moja.” Mwili wangu haukuwa unanenepa, lakini pengine akili yangu ilikuwa inazidi kunenepa.
text.Unused input becomes weight in the mind: Ingizo ambalo halijatumika huwa uzito akilini
text.First, here is the word I want you to re: Kwanza, hili ndilo neno ninalotaka ulikumbuke leo: Metabo ya Maarifa.
text.Working in the Philippines and Japan, th: Nikifanya kazi Ufilipino na Japani, tofauti niliyohisi ilikuwa ni watu wangapi
